coordinate_frame.name: checkpoint_normalized_body_frame

axes.x: aircraft longitudinal axis; increasing generally nose-to-tail and downstream
axes.y: spanwise axis on the published half-model

coordinate_frame.center_and_reference_length_binding: the immutable per-case center and L_ref used by the checkpoint inference contract

regions.predicate: -1.75 <= x < 1.85 and -1.35 <= y < -0.25 and -0.35 <= z < 0.35, excluding higher-precedence regions
-1.75 <= x < 1.85 and -0.25 <= y < 2.50 and -0.35 <= z < 0.35, excluding higher-precedence regions

surface.semantic_limit: The first three regions are frozen Cartesian envelopes, not CAD part, named-STL-solid, CFD patch, slat, flap, wing, nacelle, or installation labels. The current named-STL classifier is validated only for exact Cp-cut segment midpoints and is not promoted here to all native boundary points. The remainder includes all geometry outside the proxy envelopes.

signed_distance.definition: PhysicsNeMo signed_distance_field(use_sign_winding_number=True) evaluated from the immutable case-local STL in checkpoint-normalized coordinates

regions.predicate: 1.50 <= x < 5.00 and abs(y) < 2.75 and -1.50 <= z < 1.50, excluding near_airframe_sdf_band
-5.00 <= x < 5.00 and abs(y) < 5.00 and -4.00 <= z < 4.00, excluding higher-precedence regions
all remaining retained native volume points

volume.semantic_limit: The aft-airframe wake region is a body-frame Cartesian proxy and includes flow near tail geometry; it is not a streamline-, vortex-, boundary-layer-, or topology-derived wake label. Signed distance is geometric distance to the complete case-local STL, not distance to a specific high-lift component.

metric_semantics.regional_relative_l2_percent: 100*sqrt(sum(region_weight*||prediction-truth||^2)/sum(region_weight*||truth||^2)); this is normalized by signal energy inside the selected region and remains a local diagnostic
metric_semantics.whole_support_normalized_rmse_percent: 100*sqrt(sum(region_weight*||prediction-truth||^2)/sum(region_weight))/sqrt(sum(whole_support_weight*||truth||^2)/sum(whole_support_weight)); the denominator is the truth RMS over the complete case field support, so a near-zero local signal cannot make the regional comparison singular or arbitrarily large
metric_semantics.r2: 1-sum(region_weight*||prediction-truth||^2)/sum(region_weight*||truth-weighted_region_mean_truth||^2); null with an explicit status when regional target variance is zero
metric_semantics.component_metrics: the same formulas applied independently to ordered vector components
metric_semantics.vector_reduction: vector RMSE and truth RMS both flatten the same ordered components, so their ratio is dimensionless and component-count invariant
metric_semantics.chunk_protocol: accumulate additive sufficient statistics per region and derive metrics only after the complete case closes; never average chunk-local metrics
metric_semantics.aggregate_pooled: sum per-region additive sufficient statistics across the exact complete split before deriving metrics
metric_semantics.aggregate_macro: equal arithmetic mean of complete per-case regional derived metrics; this is the primary comparison reduction for whole_support_normalized_rmse_percent
metric_semantics.aggregate_distribution: minimum, median, p90 and maximum across every case for which the regional metric is defined

dashboard_policy.primary_label: equal-case mean regional RMSE normalized by each case's whole-volume truth RMS

required_additive_sufficient_statistics.vector_components: repeat common statistics independently for every ordered component

source_compatibility.derivation: The v2 aggregate is derived exactly from the v1 additive sufficient statistics; retained model predictions and official field metric inputs are unchanged.

future_semantic_upgrade.surface: A later separately versioned region definition may use organizer-published, all-native-point component IDs after the named-STL classifier is independently validated for coverage, ambiguity and stability across every geometry.
future_semantic_upgrade.volume: A later separately versioned region definition may replace the wake envelope with validated high-lift-component distance bands or flow/topology-aware regions.
future_semantic_upgrade.compatibility_rule: Any changed predicate, threshold, center binding, component classifier or region order requires a new definition_id and contract hash.
